path_redaction_note: Machine-specific paths have been sanitized: checkout paths are repo-relative; /example/artifacts/location-N and /example/toolchain are fictional locations scoped to this record. Measurements, revisions, and recorded hashes are unchanged.
baseline_changes: Only the identical shortest_path_scaling example and fixture were copied into an isolated archive checkout; timings use uninstrumented engine binaries.
method: Three fresh-process, fresh-in-memory-graph trials per engine and scale; 100 repeated samples plus a separate first query; engine order alternates between trials. Builds and tests finished before these sequential runs. Query timing includes planning, execution and decoding of length(p), excludes fixture setup and hydrated-path validation. Nearest-rank p50/p95; summary medians across trials. RSS covers the entire process.
fixture: 64 reachable nodes, 125 directed NEXT edges to each next one/two node, 32-hop result from 0 to 63. Each unrelated node has one disconnected NEXT self-loop.

baseline_phase_profile.method: Separate instrumented release run, 100 repeated samples after the first query. Instant timers around load_edges(), adjacency(), and the BFS/row-encoding loop in enumerate_shortest_paths(). Excludes endpoint-domain loading, drops, planning, and consuming SQLite. No concurrent builds/tests. Instrumentation removed for engine comparison.
